question: When I roll to visit my Attractions, is an Attraction visited when the number lit up on it equals the die result?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: each Attraction with a lit-up number equal to the result is visited and its visit ability triggers.
expected.answer: 701.52a To roll to visit your Attractions, roll a six-sided die. Then if you control one or more Attractions with a number lit up that is equal to that result, each of those Attractions has been “visited” and its visit ability triggers. See rule 717, “Attraction Cards,” and rule 702.159, “Visit.”

whyHard: Players treat the roll as a general effect and forget that the lit-up numbers decide which Attractions are visited.
